versions.statement: Notion的核心用户画像是跨职能团队负责人，负责整合文档和任务
Notion的核心用户群体是跨职能团队负责人，他们使用Notion整合文档和任务；Notion在软件行业内广泛使用，但在行业外鲜为人知。

segments: cross-functional team lead consolidating docs and tasks
widely used inside the software industry but little known outside it
pain_points: heavy bias toward people who work for software companies

versions.statement: Notion的主要用户群体包括跨职能团队负责人和软件行业从业者，这些用户使用Notion整合文档和任务。

segments: cross-functional team lead consolidating docs and tasks
people who work for software companies
pain_points: steep learning curve—most people can't go from taking simple notes to managing databases in an afternoon
heavy bias toward people who work for software companies
makes Notion hard to recommend to the average person
